sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SYNOPTIC PATTERN WILL CHANGE LITTLE THROUGH TODAY WITH PRIMARY BELT OF WLYS OVER THE NRN TIER STATES AND UPPER RIDGE PERSISTING OVER THE SRN HALF OF THE COUNTRY. NWRN PORTION OF THE RIDGE WILL BE SUPPRESSED BY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY LOCATED OFF THE PACIFIC NW COAST. THIS FEATURE WILL ADVANCE EWD THROUGH THE NRN ROCKIES...EMERGING OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS OF ERN MT LATER TONIGHT...PRECEDED BY A LOW-AMPLITUDE IMPULSE. FARTHER EAST A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE THROUGH THE NERN STATES EARLY TODAY FOLLOWED BY AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE THIS EVENING. SFC LOW WILL DEVELOP OVER ERN MT LATER TODAY IN RESPONSE TO HEIGHT FALLS/INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT PRECEDING THE AFOREMENTIONED SHORTWAVE TROUGH. A WARM FRONT WILL EXTEND EWD FROM THE LOW AND DEVELOP NWD THROUGH THE DAKOTAS. FARTHER EAST A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE INTO THE NERN STATES LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS AREA
sections.text: RESERVOIR OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH LOW 70S DEWPOINTS REMAINS IN PLACE OVER THE CNTRL/NRN PLAINS AREA. ESELY NEAR-SFC WINDS WILL PERSIST NORTH OF WARM FRONT AND HELP TO MAINTAIN CORRIDOR OF RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE OVER THE DAKOTAS INTO ERN MT. BY LATE AFTERNOON SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD RANGE FROM THE UPPER 50S TO LOW 60S OVER ERN MT TO MID 60S/NEAR 70F FARTHER EAST OVER THE DAKOTAS BENEATH 8-8.5 C/KM MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH THE ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. THESE PROCESS AND DIABATIC WARMING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE FROM 1500 J/KG OVER ERN MT TO 3500 J/KG OVER THE CNTRL/ERN DAKOTAS. SHORTWAVE RIDGING WILL DOMINATE THE UPPER PATTERN MOST OF THE DAY. THIS ALONG WITH A CAPPING INVERSION AT BASE OF THE EML SHOULD LIMIT MORE ROBUST STORM INITIATION UNTIL LATER IN THE AFTERNOON...WHEN STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP INITIALLY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF MT AND NRN WY AND IN ASSOCIATION WITH MINOR LEAD IMPULSE. WIND PROFILES WILL STRENGTHEN WITH 40+ KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AS INITIAL STORM MODE. EARLY STORMS WILL BE HIGH BASED AND POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DOWNBURST WINDS. STORMS WILL EVENTUALLY INTERCEPT RICHE

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE THROUGH SERN CANADA AND NRN NEW ENGLAND LATER THIS MORNING WITH DRYING ALOFT ADVECTING INTO THE NERN STATES IN WAKE OF THIS FEATURE. STORMS MAY DEVELOP AND INTENSIFY OVER MAINE AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES THROUGH THE LATE MORNING. FARTHER SOUTHWEST...ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP DURING THE DAY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES. HOWEVER...DRYING ALOFT IN WAKE OF LEAD WAVE MAY DILUTE UPDRAFT STRENGTH AND LIMIT STORM COVERAGE...LOWERING OVERALL CONFIDENCE IN A MORE ROBUST SEVERE THREAT. NEVERTHELESS....30-40 KT DEEP-LAYER WINDS AND STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED DOWNBURST WINDS WHERE STORMS DEVELOP IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR DURING THE AFTERNOON. ..DIAL/LEITMAN.. 07/22/2016

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES
sections.text: AN INITIAL CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER SRN QUEBEC ASSOCIATED WITH THE LEAD SHORT WAVE TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO MOVE ESEWD ACROSS NRN ME EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. SUFFICIENT DIABATIC HEATING AND SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE 60S ARE RESULTING IN AN UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MUCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG. SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR OF 30-40 KT IN THE LOWEST 6 KM WILL PROMOTE ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL. STRONGER CELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND OCCASIONAL HAIL. OTHER ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS MAY DEVELOP FROM PARTS OF SRN NY AND NERN PA THIS AFTERNOON AND SPREAD EWD WITH TIME. ALTHOUGH WINDS ALOFT/VERTICAL SHEAR IS WEAKER WITH SWD GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT...STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGEST POTENTIAL FOR PRIMARILY STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH STRONGER CELLS. ANOTHER CLUSTER OF STORMS MAY DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER NRN NY AND NRN NEW ENGLAND IN RESPONSE TO THE UPSTREAM SHORT WAVE TROUGH. THESE STORMS WILL ALSO HAVE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE STRONG WIND GUSTS AND POSSIBLE HAIL.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS TO IA
sections.text: AFTERNOON MESOSCALE ANALYSIS INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF A HIGHER THETAE AIR EXTENDING NORTHWESTWARD INTO NORTHERN SD AND SOUTH-CENTRAL TO SOUTHWEST ND TO EASTERN MT...WITH THE PRESENCE OF SURFACE DEW POINTS INTO THE LOWER 70S ACROSS THESE AREAS AND VALUES INTO THE MID-UPPER 70S WITH SOUTHEAST EXTENT THROUGH EASTERN SD AND CENTRAL/NORTHERN IA. THIS IS RESULTING IN A VERY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE RANGING FROM 3000-5000 J/KG. GIVEN ONGOING STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS IN NORTH-CENTRAL SD AND THE PRESENCE OF A FAVORABLE CAPE/SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE...THE SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN EXPANDED TO INCLUDE THE REST OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN SD INTO THE NORTHERN HALF OF IA. IN ADDITION TO THE POTENTIAL FOR SIGNIFICANT SIZE HAIL IN THE WESTERN PART OF THE ENHANCED RISK AREA...THERE IS CONCERN ALSO FOR SIGNIFICANT WIND SPEEDS/DAMAGE TO OCCUR THIS EVENING AS DEVELOPING STORMS IN SOUTHEAST MT AND NORTHEAST WY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS ACROSS SOUTHERN ND AND NORTHERN SD. FARTHER SOUTHEAST...A SIGNIFICANT HAIL THREAT HAS BEEN ADDED FOR PART OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN SD...GIVEN THE VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES.

sections.title: NORTHERN AND CENTRAL IA
sections.text: THE SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN EXPANDED INTO THIS REGION AS THE ENVIRONMENT IS BECOMING CONDUCIVE FOR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. REFER TO SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1359 FOR ADDITIONAL MESOSCALE DETAILS IN THIS REGION.

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES
sections.text: TRENDS IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT SUGGEST THE GREATEST SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT THROUGH THE REST OF THE AFTERNOON TO EARLY EVENING WILL BE ACROSS MAINE...SINCE THIS REGION IS LOCATED CLOSER TO THE STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THE REST OF THE NORTHEAST STATES COULD HAVE ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT... THOUGH MUCH OF THE AREAS SOUTHWEST OF MAINE RESIDES BETWEEN THE TROUGH APPROACHING MAINE AND THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH FARTHER UPSTREAM IN CENTRAL ONTARIO /NORTHEAST OF LAKE SUPERIOR/. ..PETERS.. 07/22/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1132 AM CDT FRI JUL 22 2016/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE MOUTH OF THE ST. LAWRENCE RIVER WILL LIKELY INTENSIFY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AS THEY MOVE EWD INTO NRN MAINE. A FEW STRONGER STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF A LOCALIZED HAIL/WIND THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE-SATELLITE IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA SHOW A A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS NEAR THE MOUTH OF THE ST. LAWRENCE RIVER. SURFACE CONDITIONS DOWNSTREAM OF THE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY HAVE WARMED IN THE LOWER 80S WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW-MID 60S DEG F ALONG AND AHEAD OF AN APPROACHING COLD FRONT. AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO HEAT...LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION FROM THE SW OVER SERN QUEBEC MAY LEAD TO ADDITIONAL DESTABILIZATION WITH AROUND 1000 J/KG MLCAPE EXPECTED. WEAK NEAR-SURFACE SWLY FLOW IS SURMOUNTED BY STRENGTHENING WLY FLOW WITH HEIGHT THROUGH THE MID LEVELS--RESULTING IN 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. AS SUCH...IT IS EXPECTED STORMS WILL GRADUALLY INTENSIFY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. SOME STORM ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE AND THE STRONGER STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF A LOCALIZED DAMAGING-WIND/MARGINALLY SEVERE-HAIL THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF TSTMS WILL SPREAD SWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS...AND WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY...THOUGH CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE CORES HAVE SHOWN SIGNS OF MODEST INTENSIFICATION IMMEDIATELY BEHIND THE LEADING EDGE OF OUTFLOW SPREADING SWD ACROSS PARTS OF WRN KY. THE AIR MASS S OF THE CORRESPONDING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IS BECOMING VERY UNSTABLE...WITH STRONG SFC HEATING AMIDST DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE/UPPER 70S SUPPORTING MLCAPE AROUND 2500-4000 J/KG. WITH SWELLING CU FIELDS BECOMING EVIDENT S OF THE BOUNDARY...THERE IS GROWING CONCERN THAT A MORE ABRUPT INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/INTENSITY WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS ACTIVITY COULD ALSO DEVELOP WWD INVOF THE BOUNDARY INTO SERN MO AND NERN AR. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY...INTENSE CONVECTIVE CORES CAPABLE OF STRONG MICROBURSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE -- AIDED BY PRECIPITATION LOADING. DEEP SHEAR IS WEAK...WHICH WILL LIMIT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION. HOWEVER...LOCALLY CONSOLIDATING COLD POOLS MAY FOSTER ISOLATED INSTANCES OF CONVECTIVE UPSCALE GROWTH AND MULTICELL CLUSTERING -- PERHAPS ENCOURAGING SHORT CORRIDORS OF DMGG-WIND REPORTS. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE DEARTH OF DEEP SHEAR...CONVECTION IS PRESENTLY EXPECTED TO BE TOO DISORGANIZED FOR WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE SPREADING SWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF SRN OH AND PERHAPS INTO NRN KY THROUGH THE EARLY/MID AFTERNOON HOURS. A FEW INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A TSTM CLUSTER CONTINUES SPREADING SWD ACROSS OHIO...WHICH DEVELOPED EARLY IN THE MORNING WITHIN A TRAILING ZONE OF ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING THE NERN CONUS. THIS ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO DISLODGE FROM STRONGER TROPOSPHERIC WIND FIELDS ACCOMPANYING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. WITH INSOLATION/DESTABILIZATION OCCURRING S OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION...PROPAGATION WILL BE THE PRIMARY DRIVER FOR SUBSEQUENT TSTM MOTION SWD THROUGH PARTS OF SRN OHIO -- CENTERED ON THE LOWER SCIOTO RIVER VALLEY -- THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE CONVECTION IS LARGELY EVOLVING IN AN ANAFRONTAL-FLOW REGIME...INCIPIENT INTENSIFYING CORES ARE BECOMING BETTER DEFINED IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE AMALGAMATED MESO-BETA-SCALE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY PRECEDING DEEPER CONVECTION. THIS IS LIKELY IN RESPONSE TO CONTINUED EROSION OF MLCINH...WHILE MLCAPE HAS INCREASED TO AROUND 2000 J/KG IN THE CONVECTIVELY-UNPERTURBED ENVIRONMENT -- BASED ON A MODIFIED 12Z WILMINGTON OHIO RAOB. AS SUCH...SOME RISK FOR STRONGER TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SWD TOWARD/ACROSS THE OHIO RIVER AND PERHAPS INTO NRN KY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. PRECIPITATION-LOADING PROCESSES MAY SUPPORT A FEW INSTANCES OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS...THOUGH THE PAUCITY OF DEEP SHEAR WILL MITIGATE CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND A GREATER SVR RISK. CONVECTIVE PROCESSING ACCOMPANYING THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD GREATLY LIMIT PROSPECTS FOR ROBUST CONVECTION IN ITS WAKE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR INCREASING SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE NOT IMMEDIATELY LIKELY...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. LATER THIS AFTERNOON...WW PROBABILITIES MAY INCREASE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER-VAPOR LOOPS INDICATE A SUBTLE...LOW-AMPLITUDE... MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX CRESTING THE N-S MID-LEVEL RIDGE POSITIONED OVER THE GREAT PLAINS. WITH POCKETS OF INSOLATION OCCURRING AMIDST THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IN ADVANCE OF THE SPEED MAX -- E.G. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER/MIDDLE 70S -- MLCINH IS ERODING. MEANWHILE...THERE HAS BEEN AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/INTENSITY ACROSS PORTIONS OF FAR S-CNTRL ND. MLCAPE DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY HAS INCREASED TO AROUND 2500-5000 J/KG...AND WILL PROMOTE THE POTENTIAL FOR ROBUST CONVECTION -- ESPECIALLY IF IT WERE TO BECOME SFC-BASED. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE RELATIVELY EARLY CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE...AND GIVEN THE SUBTLE CHARACTER OF THE MECHANISMS FAVORING LARGER-SCALE ASCENT...THERE IS CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY REGARDING THE SVR POTENTIAL DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. REGARDLESS...THE AFOREMENTIONED BUOYANCY COMBINED WITH 35-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUGGESTS THAT AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR HAIL/WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE...AS CONVECTION POTENTIALLY TRANSITIONS FROM INGESTING ELEVATED INFLOW TO SFC-BASED INFLOW. IF CONVECTIVE UPSCALE GROWTH WERE TO YIELD A MORE SVR WIDESPREAD RISK -- PERHAPS EMANATING FROM A MORE PROMINENT TSTM/SUPERCELL CLUSTER AND/OR MCS -- WW ISSUANCE MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. LATER THIS AFTERNOON...WITH ADDITIONAL SFC HEATING/DESTABILIZATION...WW PROBABILITIES MAY BE INCREASING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASE IN THE SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL IS ANTICIPATED WITHIN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS INCLUDES THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...SVR WINDS...AND PERHAPS ONE OR TWO TORNADOES. THE ISSUANCE OF A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES SUGGEST INCREASINGLY AGITATED...HIGH-BASED CUMULUS FIELDS DEVELOPING INVOF A NW/SE AXIS THROUGH SERN MT. THIS ACTIVITY LIES AT THE EDGE OF THE HOTTEST SFC TEMPERATURES/DEEPEST BOUNDARY LAYER EXTENDING OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN. LOCATIONS FARTHER N/NE/E ARE ENTRENCHED WITHIN A COMPARATIVELY COOLER -- THOUGH CONSIDERABLY MOISTER -- BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S TO THE LOWER 70S. SURMOUNTING MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 7.5-8.0 C/KM IN THE H7-H5 LAYER PER 12Z GGW/BIS RAOBS ARE SUPPORTING STRONG DIURNAL GAINS IN INSTABILITY. MLCAPE AROUND 2000-4500 J/KG CHARACTERIZES THE VICINITY A MOIST AXIS INVOF THE ND/SD BORDER WWD INTO ADJACENT EXTREME ERN MT. WEAKER BUOYANCY EXISTS WITH NWD EXTENT INTO NRN ND/NRN MT -- AMIDST DRIER/CONTINENTAL AIR. THE BIS VWP IS SAMPLING AROUND 45-50 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK SHEAR...AIDED BY MODEST LOW-LEVEL ELYS SURMOUNTED BY MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS. THE AFOREMENTIONED CAPE/SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE WILL ESTABLISH THE POTENTIAL FOR SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE COMBINATION OF EARLY-DAY DEVELOPMENT OF THE AFOREMENTIONED SERN-MT CUMULUS FIELD...COUPLED WITH PERSISTENT ACCAS FIELDS NEWD/EWD INTO S-CNTRL ND AND NWRN SD...SUGGEST THAT AT LEAST SOME DEGREE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IS PRESENT ACROSS THE REGION. CONSISTENT WITH THIS NOTION...WATER VAPOR LOOPS DEPICT SUBTLE...SMALL-SCALE PERTURBATIONS/SPEED MAXIMA ADVANCING THROUGH THE FLOW ON THE NWRN RIM OF A BROAD MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE CNTRL CONUS. THE COLLECTIVE EFFECT OF THESE FEATURES...COMBINED WITH CONTINUED DIABATIC SFC-LAYER HEATING...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN UPTICK OF CONVECTION ACROSS THE REGION -- ESPECIALLY IN THE 20Z-22Z PERIOD. INITIAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL BE CAPABLE OF SUPPORTING LARGE HAIL AND SVR WINDS. ELY

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE INCREASE IN THE SVR-TSTM RISK THIS AFTERNOON...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCIPIENT CONVECTIVE TOWERS ARE BUILDING ON THE WARM SIDE OF A W/E DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING ZONE ACROSS NRN IA. ON THE WARM SIDE OF THIS ZONE AND FARTHER S...DEWPOINTS WELL INTO THE 70S COMBINED WITH AMPLE SFC HEATING ARE SUPPORTING SUBSTANTIAL BUOYANCY. LARGE-SCALE VERTICAL MOTION IS LARGELY NEUTRAL...AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS WEAK. HOWEVER...VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS WOULD SUGGEST THAT THE DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING-INDUCED BAROCLINICITY AMIDST BACKGROUND CONFLUENCE IS SUFFICIENT FOR AN UPTICK IN CONVECTION. GIVEN REPEATED CONVECTIVE ATTEMPTS AND DIURNAL MUTING OF MLCINH...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT MORE ROBUST CONVECTION COULD DEVELOP DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. IF THAT WERE TO OCCUR...THE PRESENCE OF 3000-5000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WOULD SUPPORT ROBUST UPDRAFT MASS FLUXES IN SUPPORT OF A CONDITIONAL SVR WIND/HAIL RISK. DEEP SHEAR IS WEAK...THOUGH 10-20 KT OF WLY/NWLY FLOW AT H5 MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR MULTICELL CLUSTERING AS INTENSE COLD POOLS POTENTIALLY EVOLVE/MERGE AND SPREAD GENERALLY SEWD. IF IT WERE TO APPEAR THAT A MORE CONCENTRATED CORRIDOR OF SVR POTENTIAL WERE TO EXIST...WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/SEVERE GUST THREAT WILL LIKELY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON. RELATIVELY LIMITED SEVERE STORM COVERAGE WILL SEEMINGLY PRECLUDE A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE-SATELLITE IMAGERY LOOP AND SURFACE OBSERVATIONS CONFIRM VERY STRONG HEATING HAS OCCURRED TODAY AND HAS ACTED TO PRECONDITION A WEAKENING IN THE CAP AND EROSION OF MLCINH EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WEAK FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE MOVING ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF WY INTO WRN SD PER WATER-VAPOR IMAGERY HAS AIDED STORM DEVELOPMENT. RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING IN A NW TO SE BAND FROM NIOBRARA COUNTY WY SEWD INTO THE NRN NEB PANHANDLE. VERY LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS RANGING FROM 45-55 DEG F RESULTING IN NEARLY DRY-ADIABATIC LAPSE RATES ON THE WRN EDGE OF THE MOISTURE RESERVOIR --WHICH IS LOCATED OVER THE SANDHILLS AND CNTRL SD-- WILL FACILITATE EFFICIENT DOWNBURSTS VIA EVAPORATIVE COOLING. AS STORMS ACQUIRE LARGE CORES...AN ISOLATED RISK FOR SEVERE GUSTS WILL CORRESPONDINGLY INCREASE. LARGE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS MANAGING TO SUSTAIN MORE THAN BRIEF ROTATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR-TSTM RISK WILL BE DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON...DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THAT CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING IN RESPONSE TO DIURNALLY ENHANCED OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS IN PROXIMITY TO THE ROCKY MOUNTAIN FRONT AND TOWARD THE SWRN MT MOUNTAINS. THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF DCVA ACCOMPANYING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH PROGRESSING ACROSS THE NRN GREAT BASIN...AND ASCENT RELATED TO SMALL-SCALE PERTURBATIONS EMBEDDED WITHIN BROADER ANTICYCLONIC FLOW FARTHER SE...ARE ALSO ENCOURAGING THE UPTICK IN CONVECTION. SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 40S TO THE 50S -- EXISTS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF MT TO SUPPORT MARGINAL/MODERATE INSTABILITY IN THESE AREAS. CONVECTION MAY INCREASE IN INTENSITY AS IT SPREADS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. GIVEN THE OVERALL MODEST NATURE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...THE OVERALL SVR RISK WILL REMAIN ISOLATED. HOWEVER...THE H7-H5 LAPSE RATE AROUND 8.9 C/KM SAMPLED BY THE 12Z GREAT FALLS MT RAOB SUPPORTS THE POTENTIAL FOR SUBSTANTIAL UPDRAFT ACCELERATIONS. THESE ACCELERATIONS...COMBINED WITH AROUND 35-55 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...SUGGEST A FEW ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL MAY OCCUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR PRIMARILY DAMAGING GUSTS CONTINUES AND THE THREAT AREA WILL SHIFT SLOWLY SOUTH AND EAST AS CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING STABILIZES THE BOUNDARY LAYER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A FEW SMALL CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS TRAVERSING EASTWARD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN AND N-CNTRL MAINE. SURFACE CONDITIONS TO THE SOUTH AND EAST OF THE ONGOING ACTIVITY REMAIN SUPPORTIVE FOR A CONTINUED STRONG/SEVERE THREAT. THE KCBW VAD SHOWS WLY FLOW INCREASING TO 50 KT AROUND 6 KM ARL. THE STRENGTH OF FLOW COUPLED WITH WEAK TO MODERATE BUOYANCY /MLCAPE 750-1250 J PER KG/ WILL YIELD POTENTIAL FOR SMALL LINE SEGMENTS TO BE CAPABLE OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE GUSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE. ..SMITH.. 07/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK CONTINUES ACROSS WW 409.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL-SCALE...INTENSE TSTM CLUSTER CONTINUES SPREADING SSEWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN SD. EXTREME INSTABILITY CHARACTERIZES CONVECTIVE INFLOW...AND THIS CONVECTION SHOULD CONTINUE TRACKING SSEWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF WW 409 DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS WILL ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY. CONVECTION DEVELOPING ATOP WWD-FLANKING OUTFLOW MAY ALSO POSE A SVR RISK. WHILE MESO-BETA-SCALE CONVECTIVE PROCESSING IS ONGOING WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION...THE SPATIAL EXTENT OF THIS PROCESSING IS RELATIVELY MODEST. MODIFICATION OF THE ANTECEDENT PROCESSED AIR DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS MAY FACILITATE AN INCREASING SVR RISK ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING...WHILE CONVECTION DEVELOPS TO THE W AND SPREADS EWD. ..COHEN.. 07/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS ARE EXPECTED WITH THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS GRADUALLY EXPANDING IN AREAL COVERAGE ALONG THE ND/SD BORDER. MULTIPLE THUNDERSTORM UPDRAFTS ARE BEGINNING TO CLUSTER ACROSS THIS REGION AND AN MCS MAY ULTIMATELY EVOLVE BEFORE SLOWLY PROPAGATING SEWD ACROSS THE MAIN BODY OF WW409/410. MRMS HAIL ALGORITHM SUGGESTS SEVERE HAIL HAS BEEN COMMON WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. ADDITIONALLY...VERY HOT SFC TEMPERATURES ACROSS WRN SD FAVOR STRONG DOWNDRAFTS GIVEN THE 50F TEMP/DEW POINT SPREADS. WEAK LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION MAY ALSO AID LONGEVITY OF THIS ACTIVITY INTO THE EVENING HOURS. ..DARROW.. 07/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS WILL PROPAGATE SEWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS MAY BE NOTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DIURNALLY DRIVEN CONVECTION THAT INITIATED ACROSS THE NEBRASKA PANHANDLE INTO NERN CO HAS EVOLVED INTO SEVERAL STRONG THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ALONG WRN FRINGE OF HIGHER QUALITY MOISTURE. 00Z SOUNDING FROM LBF EXHIBITED EXTREME SBCAPE WITH BULK SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED MULTI-CELL UPDRAFTS...ESPECIALLY GIVEN THE OBSERVED INSTABILITY. LARGE HAIL IS LIKELY NOTED WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS...ESPECIALLY OVER SWRN NEBRASKA. AS WEAK BRANCH OF LLJ INCREASES ACROSS NWRN KS INTO THIS ACTIVITY THERE MAY BE A PROPENSITY FOR THIS COMPLEX TO REMAIN ORGANIZED AS IT PROPAGATES SLOWLY SEWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FOCUS ACROSS NERN MT INTO WRN ND OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HAIL AND WIND ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LLJ IS FORECAST TO INCREASE ACROSS THE WRN DAKOTAS IN RESPONSE TO 500MB SPEED MAX APPROACHING THE MT/SK BORDER. ORGANIZED CONVECTION IS ONGOING AHEAD OF THE SPEED MAX ACROSS SWRN SK AND THE TRAILING SFC FRONT IS PROGRESSING STEADILY EWD ACROSS CNTRL MT. NEW TSTMS MAY EVOLVE ACROSS NERN MT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD INTO WRN ND WHERE LLJ IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE. HAIL AND WIND ARE THE MAIN THREATS. MUCH OF CNTRL ND HAS STABILIZED DUE TO EARLIER CONVECTION. WW MAY BE CANCELED EARLY ACROSS THIS REGION. ..DARROW.. 07/23/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
